title: Rosie entrance and tavern side/rear route suggestions
coordinate_system: Godot XZ planar coordinates, meters; Godot Y is terrain height. Blender (x,y,z) maps to Godot (x,z,-y).
evidence: Current exported town/coast/rocks GLB transformed world positions for tables, supplies and rocks.
Current foliage GLB low vertices for seaward palm.
Conservative gap rock/shrub boxes from captures/rock_earth_rebuild_20261121/obstructions.json; actual exported rock faces are slightly inside these boxes.
Current terrain GLB triangle barycentric height samples; this does not inspect newly unsaved Blender changes.

routes.name: rosie_door_inner_entry
routes.requires_grading: Only final contact must follow parent step-grounding result; existing interior ground is about 1.18.
scope_notes: Passes between the two table-chair groups.
Stop at the approach to Town_Step.001; do not paint up the vertical riser.
This short piece does not by itself connect a lower public lane.
routes.sampled_height_status: Actual exported terrain triangles at recorded SHA-256; source may subsequently be edited by parent.

routes.name: tavern_rear_short_access
routes.requires_grading: Current centerline height is approximately 1.65; inspect cross-slope and foundation edge before forming a narrow service path.
scope_notes: Rear/east side, between tavern footing and cliff.
Stop before z43.0 because the downstream shrub and boulder corridor narrows.
This is rear access only, not a certified rear-to-Rosie through-route.
Only extend if actual visible need justifies this narrow path.
routes.sampled_height_status: Actual exported terrain triangles at recorded SHA-256; source may subsequently be edited by parent.

routes.name: tavern_rosie_gap_west_pocket
routes.requires_grading: Yes. The pocket drops below the tavern and rises again toward Rosie; centerline heights are evidence, not target grades. Resolve into a deliberate small ramp/landing before road masking.
scope_notes: Runs west of the gap boulders and east of the Rosie left supply pile.
At z45.6-46.4, keep path west edge greater than x14.05 to clear the barrel at x13.857.
At z43.4-45.2, keep east edge less than x14.85 to leave clearance from the boulders starting near x15.10.
End on the near/north side of Rosie. Do not continue straight through its footprint.
The start should join an actual tavern side landing; it is not an invented rear doorway.

routes.name: rosie_lower_approach_probe
routes.requires_grading: Yes; current height climbs about 0.64 m in 1.10 m. This cannot be accepted by material painting alone.
scope_notes: No table/chair conflict along this central-door axis.
Requires a designed ramp or actual steps before joining the short entry.
Do not expand the earth-colored mask into the full terrace as a substitute for the connection.
routes.sampled_height_status: Actual exported terrain triangles at recorded SHA-256; source may subsequently be edited by parent.

decision: Recommend the Rosie interior door approach first. Treat the tavern rear stub and west gap pocket as conditional narrow connections, and do not claim a complete rear through-route without a new clearance/grade design. No asset moves were performed or assumed in this read-only suggestion.
